title: Zau Li Wong

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 328
Date 15/5/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

May 13th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that a new pro-rebel newspaper will
appear in Shanghai soon. The journal will be called the
Ghoong Wo Sing Pao 共和新報 and it will be published
at No.14 Rue du Consulat.
Seven hundred recruits arrived in Shanghai yesterday
by the cruiser "Yong Fong" and went into billets
at Doo Sz Khoong Su 圖書公司 .
It is reported that Sun Yat Sen will soon go to
Canton in response to an invitation from the rebel
military Government there.
It is reported that considerable difference of
opinion exists among the rebel leaders of Chekiang,
and that it is probable that they will fight among themselves.
On 11th inst General Yang received a telegram from
Chiangchun Feng requesting that he or Deputy Military Governor
Lu proceed to Nanking to discuss some important affairs.
After a consultation the generals came to the conclusion
that it would not be wise for either of them to leave
Shanghai and they decided to send a staff officer named
Zau Li Wong 趙有道 in their place. The latter left for
Nanking yesterday.
X Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 is again reported to be in
the French Concession. It appears that he sent a
representative to Shantung who assumed his name but he did
X not go himself.

Your Obedient Servant,

McMustin

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

13/5 - Anh / 15/5
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记处
第 328 号
日期 1916年5月15日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年5月13日

先生：

据报，一份新的拥戴叛军报纸即将在上海问世。该报名称为《共和新報》，将在领事馆路14号出版。

七百名新兵昨日乘巡洋舰“永丰”号抵达上海，并入住图书公司宿舍。

据报，孙中山应广东叛军军事政府之邀，即将前往广州。

据报，浙江叛军领导人之间存在严重意见分歧，他们很可能发生内讧。

本月11日，杨将军收到张勋发来的电报，要求他或副督军卢永祥前往南京商讨重要事务。经协商，各位将军认为他们二人离开上海均非明智之举，遂决定派遣一名名为趙有道的参谋军官代为前往。后者已于昨日启程赴南京。

另据报，陳其美再次现身法租界。看来他派遣了一名代表前往山东，该代表冒用其名，但他本人并未前往。

您顺从的仆人，

麦克马斯廷

首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监。

5月13日 - 安赫 / 5月15日
